meta.name: tax
meta.description: Structures the tax questions a growing business faces — corporate income, sales and use, payroll, nexus, and the obligations created by hiring or selling somewhere new. Use this to work out what a new state or country obligates you to, prepare for a tax filing or audit, understand sales tax on your product, or check what a remote hire or new market triggers.

copy.tagline: 明确企业税务义务，备好报税与审计。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果企业正走向新市场,需要理清税务义务。
copy.tagline_en: Clarify your business tax obligations and prepare for filings and audits.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your growing business needs to understand tax duties in new jurisdictions.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把税务问题结构化：按公司所得税、销售税、工资税及 nexus（产生纳税义务的关联）分门别类，提示该问什么、要备什么，并提醒重大事项须找税务顾问核实。
howto.when: 当你说到新地方招人或卖货、要报税或做审计准备、或想弄清产品要不要缴销售税时，技能会介入并梳理该问什么。

say.text: 我要在得州雇一个远程员工，会新产生哪些税和登记义务？
say.note: 技能会按 nexus 逻辑列出德州的工资税、登记等关注点。

say.text: 我这款 SaaS 在纽约州要收销售税吗？
say.note: 它会拆解产品应税性，并提示这类结论最好书面确认。

say.text: 公司第一次进入加拿大市场，该查哪些税和触发点？
say.note: 技能会梳理新国家的 nexus、登记和申报要点。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude structures tax questions into categories — corporate income, sales/use, payroll, and nexus — and tells you what to ask and prepare, flagging material items for a qualified tax adviser. It does not issue tax conclusions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention hiring or selling somewhere new, preparing a filing or audit, or asking whether sales tax applies to your product, and works out what obligations to look into.

say_en.text: I plan to hire a remote employee in Texas. What new tax and registration obligations arise?
say_en.note: It lists Texas payroll and nexus points to check.

say_en.text: Do I need to collect sales tax for my SaaS in New York?
say_en.note: It breaks down taxability and advises getting it in writing.

say_en.text: We are entering Canada for the first time. What tax triggers should we examine?
say_en.note: It outlines nexus, registrations, and filings for the new country.
